$comment: Maestro settings for this repository. The file is optional, and each field you leave out takes the default shown here. A key that starts with $ is a comment.
$baseBranch: The branch pull requests merge into. Scripts measure against origin/<baseBranch>.
$memoryDir: The shared project memory: MEMORY.md is the index, one fact per file beside it.
$blueprintMap: The map that ties paths to blueprints and review teams. With no map, the review runs its generic method and says that no blueprint was found.
$prTemplate: The pull request template that build and announce follow, when it exists.

cycle.$comment: The branch name of a task. <n> is the cycle or cooldown number, <slug> the kebab-case task.

announce.$comment: Where announce posts a ready pull request. Remove this block, and announce asks for a channel.

board.$comment: How sync pushes progress to your board, in free text: an MCP tool name, or a gh project command. Leave instructions empty, or remove this block, and sync writes progress to the pitch issue only.

prShape.$comment: Extra globs that the PR shape report leaves out of every count, on top of lock files, generated files and vendored archives. Example: docs/diagrams/**
